infinite_in_degree.rule: 39 < 40 <= minimum density degree of X_1(75) (J_1(75)(Q) is finite, so delta = gonality (Lemma 3.1 b)), and Corollary 4.3 with p = 2)

sporadic.rule: finitely many points of degree <= 39: 39 < 40 <= minimum density degree of X_1(75) (J_1(75)(Q) is finite, so delta = gonality (Lemma 3.1 b)), and Corollary 4.3 with p = 2)

isolated.rule: finitely many points of degree 39 on X_1(75), so the point lies in no positive-dimensional family

isolation.method: reduction modulo good primes (upper semicontinuity of h^0)

curve.model: Tate normal form over the residue field: y^2 + (1-c)xy - by = x^3 - bx^2, Q = (0,0)

reference: M. van Hoeij, Low degree places on the modular curve X1(N), arXiv:1202.4355; data file LowDegreePlaces_61_80 (2013/2014), line 332
notes: Imported from van Hoeij's list for N = 61..80 (one place for each degree without a known function of that degree).
